title: Garlic Congee
description: A comforting Chinese rice porridge made with garlic. A simple and soothing dish to warm your belly.
instructions: Rinse the congee and soak it in water for 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the congee again.
In a medium saucepan, combine the congee, garlic, and 2 cups of water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir occasionally to prevent the congee from sticking to the bottom of the pan.
